title:
Comment of Sarah julig in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 10/10/2026

documents.name: 151504.txt
documents.text:
Sarah julig, anchor point, AK.
I oppose all data centers in Alaska. But this underwater one has to be the most foolish I have ever heard proposed.  Why would we destroy the most valuable resources ALaska has- animals, nature, quality of life, for a speculative experiment by out of state investors? 
AI is a bubble, and will collapse.  We need to work to create real, sustainable long term local economies and greater food and small business security in alaska. We do not need this data center, or any data center.
